profile_name: Gilson PIPETMAN P200/P1000 连续量程参考情景 v1

applicability.pipette_selection_policy: P200 for 20–200 μL; P1000 for >200–1000 μL; overlap resolves to the narrower-range P200
applicability.tip_rack_note: The existing D1200ST 50–1200 μL rack does not extend the P1000 pipette's 100–1000 μL operating range. P200 uses its own recommended D200 tips.
applicability.scope_note: Only continuous interpolation between each selected pipette's manufacturer specification points is applied. The specifications are maximum permissible performance limits, not measured probability distributions and not calibration data for the simulated robot or current setup.

parameter_interpretation.systematic_error_limit_ul: manufacturer maximum systematic error magnitude; a per-run latent signed fraction is sampled uniformly in [-1, 1] and shared across all actions using the same pipette model
parameter_interpretation.repeatability_sd_limit_ul: manufacturer random error specification interpreted as a conservative repeatability standard-deviation scale for the simulation; each aspiration samples a zero-mean Gaussian approximation
parameter_interpretation.scenario_levels: low uses the manufacturer reference envelope; medium and high multiply both error scales by 1.5 and 2.0 as sensitivity scenarios. The multipliers are project scenario choices, not literature-derived device-performance tiers.
parameter_interpretation.limitations: Linear interpolation is an explicit between-anchor estimate. No behavior is claimed outside a pipette's nominal range or beyond its published anchors. Tip compatibility and the kinematic robot's ability to actuate each commercial pipette remain to be visually/operationally validated.

sources.citation: Gilson, PIPETMAN Specifications, document LT801628, single-channel P200 and P1000; manufacturer maximum permissible systematic and random errors.
sources.use_note: Reference anchors only; the specification is conditional on recommended PIPETMAN DIAMOND tips and is not a measurement of the current virtual/robotic setup.
